description: The 2026 Legislative Session, will be another consequential session for Rhode Island as we look to expand on the protections being eroded at the Federal level, and look to protect working class families in Warwick and state-wide. With these priorities in mind, I am sharing my legislative agenda to keep constituents informed, and seek feedback as I act as the elected voice for D-30 and the people of Warwick.
